announcements.headline: Namibian Copper Project Advances
announcements.insight: Following the September proposal, this update signals progress in the restructuring. Shareholders should monitor the October name change to Okopa plc for further strategic developments.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM and Change of Name to Okopa plc
announcements.insight: Following the September restoration and fundraise, Okopa plc has changed its name. This confirms the completion of the restructuring process initiated earlier this year.

announcements.headline: Director Participation in Subscription
announcements.insight: Following the September restoration and proposed fundraise, director participation confirms commitment to the capital raise. This supports the earlier proposal for investment and disposal.

announcements.headline: Restoration - Keras Resources Plc
announcements.insight: Restoration follows suspension in July. This resolves the trading halt linked to the September fundraise proposal.

announcements.headline: Proposed Investment, Disposal and Fundraise
announcements.insight: Following the June suspension, this fundraise and disposal attempt to resolve the situation. Shareholders must watch for court sanction to lift the suspension.

announcements.headline: Annual Results timing update
announcements.insight: Shares remain suspended following the June update. Shareholders must await further developments regarding the company's status.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Keras Resources Plc
announcements.insight: Keras Resources Plc shares are suspended following the earlier announcement made in June. Shareholders should monitor for further updates regarding the status of the suspension.

announcements.headline: Annual Results Update & Suspension
announcements.insight: Keras Resources shares are suspended following an annual results update. Shareholders should monitor for further regulatory developments regarding the suspension.
